title: Invoice totals off by one cent
summary: Some invoice totals were one cent short after the late fee was added.
root_cause: late_fee rounded with float arithmetic before ADR-0002; fixed with Decimal quantize.

title: Disputed invoice sent a final notice
summary: A customer with a disputed invoice received a final notice instead of a hold.
root_cause: dunning_level in app/dunning.py checked days late before the dispute flag; the nested branches made the order hard to see in review. Fixed by checking the dispute first.

title: Customer balance page slow at month end
summary: The balance page took several seconds for every customer on the first working day of the month, when finance staff all open it at once.
root_cause: Not found. The page calls GET /ledger/{customer_id}/balance; the database was idle, so the time is spent in the app. Closed without a fix.
